title: Apply manual corrections to a segmentation mask — sg_apply_corrections
text: mask sg_mask object. corrections list correction operations. element list least $action field ("split", "merge", "delete", "add"). See Details.

title: Apply manual corrections to a segmentation mask — sg_apply_corrections
text: corrected sg_mask object.

title: Apply manual corrections to a segmentation mask — sg_apply_corrections
text: correction list must contain: action = "delete" Remove cell. Requires $cell_id. action = "merge" Merge cells. Requires $cell_ids (integer vector). action = "split" Split cell. Requires $cell_id $seed_points (matrix columns row, col). action = "add" Add new cell. Requires $pixels (matrix row/col coordinates).

title: Apply manual corrections to a segmentation mask — sg_apply_corrections
code: labels <- matrix(0L, nrow = 20, ncol = 20) labels[3:8, 3:8] <- 1L labels[12:18, 12:18] <- 2L mask <- new_sg_mask(labels) corrected <- sg_apply_corrections(mask, list(   list(action = "delete", cell_id = 2L) )) #> ✔ Applied 1 correction. #> ℹ Result: 1 cell. print(corrected) #> <sg_mask>: 20 x 20, 1 cell

title: Filter cells by morphological criteria — sg_filter_cells
text: mask sg_mask object. min_area Integer. Minimum cell area pixels. Default 50L. max_area Integer. Maximum cell area pixels. Default 5000L. min_circularity Numeric [0, 1]. title: Cellpose cell segmentation — sg_segment_cellpose
text: image sg_image object. model Character string specifying Cellpose model. One "cyto3" (default), "cyto2", "nuclei", "tissuenet", "livecell", "custom". channels named list elements cytoplasm nucleus, integer channel index (0-based, following Cellpose convention). Default list(cytoplasm = 0L, nucleus = 1L). diameter Numeric NULL. Estimated cell diameter pixels. NULL, Cellpose estimates diameter automatically. flow_threshold Numeric; flow error threshold mask filtering. Default 0.4. cellprob_threshold Numeric; cell probability threshold. Default 8L. tile Logical; TRUE (default), large images processed tiles reduce memory usage.

title: Voronoi propagation from nuclear seeds — sg_segment_propagate

title: Voronoi propagation from nuclear seeds — sg_segment_propagate
code: set.seed(42) pixels <- matrix(runif(400), nrow = 20, ncol = 20) img <- new_sg_image(pixels) seeds <- matrix(0L, nrow = 20, ncol = 20) seeds[5, 5] <- 1L seeds[15, 15] <- 2L nuc_mask <- new_sg_mask(seeds) result <- sg_segment_propagate(img, nuclear_mask = nuc_mask) print(result) #> <sg_mask>: 20 x 20, 2 cells #> Method: propagate:ebimage

title: Threshold-based cell segmentation — sg_segment_threshold
code: sg_segment_threshold(   image,   channel = 1L,   method = c("otsu", "adaptive", "triangle"),   block_size = 51L,   offset = 0.05,   morphology = list(open = 5L, fill_holes = TRUE),   min_area = 50L,   max_area = 5000L )

title: Threshold-based cell segmentation — sg_segment_threshold
text: image sg_image object. channel Integer index image channel threshold. Default 1L. method Character string specifying thresholding method. One "otsu" (default), "adaptive", "triangle". block_size Integer block size adaptive thresholding. Must positive odd integer. used method = "adaptive". Default 51L. offset Numeric offset subtracted local mean adaptive thresholding. Default 0.05. morphology named list controlling morphological cleanup: open Integer; structuring element size opening (erosion dilation). Set 0L skip. Default 5L. fill_holes Logical; whether fill holes inside objects. Default TRUE. min_area Integer; minimum object area pixels. Objects smaller removed. Default 50L. max_area Integer; maximum object area pixels. Objects larger removed. Default 5000L.

title: Marker-controlled watershed segmentation — sg_segment_watershed

title: Marker-controlled watershed segmentation — sg_segment_watershed
text: image sg_image object. channel Integer index image channel used segmentation. Default 1L. seed_method Character string specifying seeds generated. One "h_minima" (default), "distance", "markers". h Numeric; height parameter h-minima distance threshold fraction seed detection. Default 0.05. min_distance Integer; minimum pixel distance seeds. Default 10L. expand_method Character string specifying seed regions expanded. One "voronoi" (default) "dilation". expand_pixels Integer; number pixels expand beyond initial watershed regions. Default 3L. membrane_channel Integer NULL. provided, channel used topographic surface watershed flooding. NULL, inverted channel image used.

title: segmantR 0.1.0
text: Initial release. Classical segmentation: adaptive thresholding, watershed, Voronoi propagation. Deep learning wrappers: Cellpose, StarDist, Mesmer (via reticulate). Human---loop annotation correction workflow. Custom model training portable model export (.segmantR archives). Feature extraction: intensity, morphology, texture, location. Shiny application six tabs interactive segmentation workflows. Export GeoJSON, QuPath, CSV, SpatialExperiment. Bundled synthetic sample data demonstrations.
